project.name: newrallyx
project.description: Contributor-built MSX2+ port with an optimized SCREEN 4 gameplay presenter and an independently maintained SCREEN 5 legacy presenter.

scope.policy: Use the established repository documentation layout. Document current contracts and retain dated measurements; module extraction belongs to issue 32. Deliver issue 34 through its dedicated PR. No new Backstage service model, graphical concession or shared-history rewrite.

historicalEvidence: outputs/ (local, ignored; exact hashes retained in docs/retired-artifacts.json)
inventory.deletionPolicy: A missing static reference is a review candidate, never proof of dead code. Keep contributor evidence locally. Confirm retention before untracking generated artifacts.

files.purpose: Contributor setup and current build selection
Current source, build and runtime ownership
Dependency inventory, retention decisions and reproducible validation
Generated file classifications and conservative static callers
Per-file retention decision, generator and original hashes
Old/new source paths and before/after hashes
Subsequent legacy/shared source relocation and validation
Script retention decisions and hashes of retired one-off probes
Legacy build selection and shared-source ownership
Maintained presenter and historical laboratory navigation
Current presenter selection and pinned source boundary
Current integration contracts and dated caveats

pipeline: Run scoped regressions and matched three-enemy profile
rules: No original ROM, extracted imagery, BIOS or emulator RAM published
Keep historical ROM hashes and performance limitations explicit

checks: Builds succeed for default, TEST_MODE=1 and LEGACY=1
ROM hashes are compared with baseline
Relevant unit and emulator regressions pass or failures remain explicit
Three-moving-enemy measurements identify ROM, workload, CPU/video and tail costs
